Browser

Your own browsing workspace. Open tabs, save bookmarks, and switch between light and dark mode.

▶ Run

Runs on its own page, outside the project hub.

How browsing works

Websites that permit embedding open inside the app. Sites that block embedding, and web searches, open in your normal browser using “Open externally.” This web app uses your existing browser engine; it does not replace Chrome or Safari.
